mpv-android.description:
mpv-android is a free, open-source multimedia player for Android, built on the powerful libmpv playback engine.

Play local video and audio files or stream media directly from network URLs, with support for a wide variety of formats and codecs.

Features include hardware and software decoding, gesture-based seeking, volume and brightness controls, support for styled subtitles through libass, secondary subtitle tracks, and configurable playback options.

Enjoy high-quality video rendering with advanced settings for scaling, debanding, and interpolation. mpv-android also supports background playback, Picture-in-Picture mode, and keyboard input.

Its lightweight interface focuses on media playback while providing powerful configuration options for users who want greater control over their viewing experience.

The application supports Android phones, tablets, and Android TV. It is open source under the MIT License and requires no subscription or account.
